test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, "ABROAD" is written as "BDUNYA", and "BECAME" is written as "CGFZKB". How will "CANCER" be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83a9b3f9d49fc4cf9c114c5bcbdc1a5d91d619f564cf91e88a3dcf504917f15.png] 

The code follows like this

A(1) + 1 = B(2)

B(2) + 2 = D(4)

R(18) + 3 = U(21)

O(15) - 1 = N(14)

A(1) - 2 = Y(25)

D(4) - 3 = A(1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6a803531a82087db78744fb509189c31fc680008e27d3df444576ae33eaeb95.png] 

**"ABROAD"** is written as** "BDUNYA"**

B(2) + 1 = C(3)

E(5) + 2 = G(7)

C(3) + 3 = F(6)

A(1) - 1 = Z(26)

M(13) - 2 = K(11)

E(5) - 3 = B(2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ac667e74bd3874ca28139b9bbe35879f9da538c0ed4479352cb909a2c1907e.png] 

**"BECAME"** is written as** "CGFZKB"**

Therefore,

C(3) + 1 = D(1)

A(1) + 2 = C(3)

N(14) + 3 = Q(17)

C(3) - 1 = B(2)

E(5) - 2 = C(3)

R(18) - 3 = O(15)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60dc10e97db6ff5daef48c1c122cfe0a808d11096641bd03cf33e5c3349c780e.png] 

**"CANCER" is written as "DCQBCO"**

Hence, the correct answer is **DCQBCO.**
